text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm… I'm absolutely terrified of all the expectations people have put on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day, I've been looking for a way for Fuji Kiseki to overcome her crippling fear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ruminate over my conundrum as I walk to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I get there, I see Fuji Kiseki inside, watching a DVD intently.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, welcome back, Trainer! I hope you don't mind me being here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A DVD of one of my mother's plays.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You know, I've never seen my mother scared on stage. Not even once.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No matter how many thousands of people are watching her, she can still act better on stage than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wonder how she's able to stay calm and collected under the weight of so many expectant eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Does it come naturally to her? Is it an act? Or is it something she had to overcome?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't know what it is, but I feel like there must be some hint in this DVD that can help me move forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems I'm not the only one desperate to find an answer to her problem. And if that's the case…
choice_data_list: May I watch it with you?
May I watch it with you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course! That's the whole reason I brought it here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The play is set in early modern France and starts with a queen locked in a prison.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: "If I could have a single wish granted, then I wish to return to the beautiful land of Austria!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jaunty music starts to play just as her mournful wail trails off, and the stage is flooded with bright light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the blink of an eye, the soot-covered queen is transformed into a sweet girl. She runs through a castle filled with lush flora.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My mother is the only actor in this play. She performs the queen in her tragic life as well as all the supporting characters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through the screen comes the judgmental glance of a servant, the retreating form of a peasant girl, the lively banter of a street performer, and the solemn soliloquy of a king.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's mother dons and sheds the personality of each character with stunning speed, but there's never confusion as to who she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each of her poignant lines draws the audience into her world, and as if in response, sighs and short cries can be heard spilling from the seats.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon, I forget that I'm watching an actor…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And we arrive at the climax of the story.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Now burn the image of my form upon those beautiful eyes of yours, dark and deep as the night!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She lets a lone bluebird free into the azure sky, and the ring of applause echoes through the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtains of the solo performance close on a never-ending standing ovation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I meant to find a clue to our problem in the show, but I ended up completely absorbed in the play.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She is. I've never seen another actor as good as her, and I'm not just saying that because I'm her daughter.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So many people want to become as skilled as her, but practically no one's succeeded. I didn't manage to either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like I have a better idea of the pinnacle Fuji Kiseki is aiming for as she attempts to be the greatest entertainer ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whenever she's onstage, she loses herself completely and becomes the very embodiment of the characters she plays.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I still have no idea what she was thinking while she was up there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surely, there's a faster way to solve this puzzle. I don't sense that her relationship with her mother is strained, so I give her a suggestion.
choice_data_list: Why not try asking her directly?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mm… I guess I could.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I've been avoiding her because I'm scared she won't understand my feelings…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But you're right. I don't have the luxury of keeping my distance after watching that performance of hers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Can you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, it's decided that we'll meet with Fuji Kiseki's mother this coming weekend.
